parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the stream belongs. The AppName value must match the AppName in the ingest URL for the template to take effect. The value can be up to 255 characters in length and can contain digits, uppercase and lowercase letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). Hyphens and underscores cannot be the first character. The value can also be a single asterisk (*) to match all AppName values.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The streaming domain of the streamer.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The sampling interval. Valid values: **5 to 3600**. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: OssBucket
parameters.description: The name of the OSS bucket.

parameters.name: OssEndpoint
parameters.description: The endpoint of the OSS bucket.

parameters.name: OssObject
parameters.description: The name of the stored image that contains violations such as pornography or politically sensitive content.
